scope: Group message context in existing moderation reports
implemented: Report source kind group uses existing report context columns, without a parallel moderation store or schema replacement.
Server verifies current reporting-user group membership, source message existence and author equality before persisting any report. Private sources cannot claim a server ID.

Group chat exposes Report Message for other authors, including spam-gated messages. Existing report dialog sends source IDs without decrypted content by default; explicit opt-in permits sharing local plaintext.
Spam inbox group reports now retain source message context, while not automatically fetching or sharing plaintext.
Existing channel and direct-message report lookup handles nil pages as unavailable rather than panicking.

Admin report description cells expose expandable source references and consented plaintext. Non-consented text is never rendered; React escapes submitted text. Turkish/English provenance warns that reporter-supplied plaintext is not independently authenticated.
